articles.title: Health Systems Shift Toward In-House Specialty Pharmacy Operations
articles.summary: Health systems are increasingly bringing specialty pharmacy services in-house to capture revenue, improve care coordination, and retain patient loyalty amidst rising drug costs. This trend matters because it alters traditional care delivery channels and shifts control of high-cost medications away from external entities. For self-funded employers and pharmacy benefit managers, this evolution presents new opportunities to partner directly with integrated health systems to negotiate better rates, manage specialty spend more effectively, and enhance overall clinical outcomes for employees.
articles.source_line: Source: Health Data Management; Mon, 24 Aug 2026 19:23:31 GMT

articles.title: Rising Health Plan Cost Risks Drive Demand For Advanced Claims Oversight
articles.summary: Recent analyses of employer-sponsored health plans reveal escalating financial risks driven by escalating medical and pharmacy expenses, emphasizing the urgent need for enhanced data transparency and rigorous claims monitoring. This trend matters because self-funded employers are increasingly vulnerable to unchecked expenditures and billing errors that inflate healthcare budgets. For business strategy, this environment creates a strong market opportunity for advanced utilization management and pharmacy benefit solutions that can proactively control costs and protect employer plan assets.
